limitations: Precursor/fragment tolerances not annotated: Mascot searches used differing precursor tolerances (0.05 or 0.1 Da) and the MaxQuant parameters used for quantification were not deposited.
characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no NCIT/EFO term for a gene-specific or non-targeting siRNA); validator warns.
Deposited Mascot .dat/.mzid for QE0380_Aysegul_030415_U_Si_150421082041 are byte-identical copies of the U_Ctrl_150421035129 search (COM/FILE point to Ctrl); the RAW file itself is distinct.

Replicate structure conflict: paper reports n = 2 biologically independent LFQ samples, but RAW headers show each condition's two files were acquired from the same vial (gb5 Ctrl, gb6 Si). Encoded as technical replicates 1/2 of one source per condition; needs author confirmation.
Di-Gly (K-epsilon-GG) antibody enrichment of all samples (paper Methods, PRIDE protocol) is not encoded: no PRIDE/EFO child of EFO:0009090 for ubiquitin-remnant peptide enrichment was found in OLS.
